title: List the Availability Zones and Regions of your account
read_only_alternative: This task is read-only. It needs no alternative. If your account does not let you start AWS CloudShell, read the AZ ID table of your Region on the AWS Availability Zones page of the Regions and Availability Zones guide.

steps.text: Open AWS CloudShell from the console. List the Availability Zones of the Region that the shell uses, with the name and the AZ ID of each zone.
steps.expect: One row per zone, and every row shows the same Region. Names such as us-east-1a sit next to IDs such as use1-az1.

steps.text: List every Region, including the Regions that your account has not enabled, with the opt-in status of each one.
steps.expect: One row per Region. Some rows show opt-in-not-required. The other rows show opted-in or not-opted-in.

steps.text: Pick one Region code from that list as <OTHER_REGION>: not your shell's Region, and with the status opt-in-not-required. List the Availability Zones of that Region.
steps.expect: A second set of zones with other names and other IDs. No zone appears in both tables.
